responsibility: This file builds and registers GCC declaration trees for the Modula-2 frontend. It owns creation of variables, constants, parameters, results, function declarations, module constructors, literal constants, and string constants; assigns visibility, storage, and context attributes; pushes declarations into m2block scopes; and triggers rest_of_decl_compilation for functions, making it the central declaration-construction layer between gm2 symbols and GCC DECL nodes.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation unit that actually builds GCC DECL and constant tree nodes, manages parameter/function construction state, assigns declaration attributes, and emits rest_of_decl_compilation. The .def and .h files only describe how to call into this declaration-building layer.
